contract.neutral: No active node UIDs means every isActive=null and neither active nor inactive modifiers execute, including links. Clear empties both sets and restores base function results.
contract.nodes: Each BFS node: base diameter, base color or inherited parent color, set boolean activity, invoke one matching modifier with complete base ComputedNode, then store final node for later endpoints/labels.
contract.links: Base thickness and base color see final nodes. If any active node exists, set link activity from its own independent edge set and invoke corresponding modifier, even when active edge set is empty.
contract.fixDepth: Infinity invokes every base color; root always resolves base; depth<=threshold resolves base, deeper nodes inherit already resolved parent color without invoking the base color function.
contract.flags: Focused node always active. Ancestor/descendant node flags are independent of ancestor/descendant link flags. Default ancestor flags true, descendant false.
contract.handlers: Default SVG node enter sets current then tooltip then callback; move does not set current; leave clears then hides then callback. Click/down/up/double do not set current. Noninteractive handler values undefined.
contract.mesh: Actual Voronoi mesh mouse move sets current even for same match, no-match clears; touch changes current only with enableTouchCrosshair. Matching is an authored input, not a Voronoi numerical oracle.
contract.rustBoundary: Rust flat IDs, radial fifth orientation, strict focus/fix-depth validation and keyboard focus are separate profile/extensions; source references do not imply nested UID or interaction/runtime parity.
